sonnet.problem: The card tells that Assyria destroyed whole kingdoms, which is violence and death. It adds a joke about it ('like a man reading off his own trophy shelf'), which also mocks Sennacherib.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.

sonnet.problem: The joke ('I would NOT want to be on the receiving end of this one') puts a threatening tone and reaction on the LORD's word and makes God's message the punchline.
sonnet.rule: Jokes never put words, tones or reactions in God's or Jesus' mouth, never cast him in God's role, and never play on a name or title of God
